name: It's a Secret to Everybody
label: Quest
description: It's a Secret to Everybody: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You see, I have no idea how I ended up here. No one really knows -- it's a secret to everybody! I just can't seem to remember anything...
These items you brought to me, though... I am remembering something.
My sword. I am supposed to strengthen it somehow, but I'm really not sure why. Sorry I can't tell you more, but I just don't remember!
Anyhoo, I do know where you can take it -- Donova Snowden in Winterspring. You'll find her by the hot springs. She can temper the sword by the pools there.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My, my... So Linken did finally get around to sending me his sword.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, of course I can temper this sword. While I'm working, you can explain what took Linken so long to get this to me. He's not usually one to forget things...
